info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizdoc-List Mortgage Loans Underwritings-v5-spec
info.description: The Mortgage Loans Underwriting API allows users to access a comprehensive list of active mortgage loan underwritings. It serves as a crucial tool for mortgage lenders and financial institutions who need to review the status and details of various underwritings. By providing real-time insights, this API enhances decision-making processes and improves operational efficiency. Typical use cases include underwriting assessments, risk evaluations, and compliance checks, making it an essential resource for loan officers and analysts.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed underwriting information for various loan applications. Use this to assess the status and criteria applied during the underwriting process.

requestBody.description: This request body is utilized to initiate the underwriting process for loan applications. The provided information is critical for evaluating the financial risk associated with loan approval.

ListMortgageLoansUnderwritingsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to loan underwriting. It is expected to be a string that may include necessary payload information.

ListMortgageLoansUnderwritingsResponse_2.title: Underwriting Response

status.description: Indicates whether the underwriting process was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number for the underwriting request.

resultId.description: An identifier for the result of the underwriting operation.

state.description: The current state of the underwriting process.

processingTimeMs.description: The amount of time taken to process the underwriting in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the underwriting result.

ListMortgageLoansUnderwritingsResponse_2.description: Represents the response object for the underwriting operation.
